en.headline: WestK Picnic Fest runs through the National Day holiday at Art Park
en.dek: The harbourfront lawn programme continues today with a shorter market and workshops, and picnic-kit rental from late morning.
body: West Kowloon Cultural District is running its first Picnic Fest on the Harbourside East Lawn at the Art Park through the National Day holiday, with today's market and workshops on a shorter timetable than the rest of the long weekend.

The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority says the fest runs on selected weekends and public holidays from 18 September to 11 October, generally from 2pm to 9pm. For Thursday's National Day, the market is scheduled from 2pm to 6pm and workshops from 2pm to 4pm. Picnic-kit rental is listed from 11am to 3pm. The same lawn programme continues from Friday to Sunday, 2 to 4 October.

Sixteen outlets in the district are offering picnic sets for the period, among them Pano, Haru, Cupping Room, Lau Bak Livehouse and Lau Kee Boat Noodles. The authority said rental of picnic equipment starts at HK$40, with a refundable deposit, and is first come, first served. A bike-and-picnic pass is also on the programme.

Authority chief executive Betty Fung Ching Suk-yee said the district wanted the fest to let visitors move between exhibitions, performances and time on the lawn. A DJ bubble party is listed for the afternoon of 4 October. Admission to the lawn programme itself is not described as ticketed.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節國慶假期續辦 藝術公園海濱東草坪
zh.dek: 西九文化區在藝術公園海濱東草坪辦野餐節，今日市集和工作坊時間較短，野餐用品上午已可租借。
body: 西九文化區首辦「西九野餐節」，國慶假期在藝術公園海濱東草坪繼續舉行。管理局公布，今日市集和工作坊的時間較其餘長周末日子短。
管理局指，野餐節由9月18日至10月11日，在選定周末及公眾假期舉行，一般為下午2時至晚上9時。國慶日周四的市集定於下午2時至6時，工作坊下午2時至4時，野餐用品租借則由上午11時至下午3時。周五至周日（10月2日至4日）草坪節目繼續，時間為下午2時至晚上9時。
區內16間指定商戶在節期推出野餐套餐，包括PANO、旭宵食堂、Cupping Room、留白Livehouse及流記艇仔粉。管理局說，野餐用品租金由40港元起，須付可退還按金，先到先得，額滿即止。節目亦包括單車野餐套票。
西九文化區管理局行政總裁馮程淑儀說，希望訪客可以一邊看展覽和演出，一邊在草坪停留。10月4日下午另有DJ泡泡派對。草坪節目本身未見列為須購票入場。
